highlights: The player bar now comes alive with the artwork, colors, and animation of the playlist you started.
A new clickable “from playlist” link makes it easy to jump back to the active playlist.
Song lists now highlight the current track with an animated playing-now equalizer.
Starting a track inside a playlist now keeps that playlist’s sorted queue and visual identity.
notes: Adds playlist-aware player-bar theming, animated customized cover art, a clickable playlist source link, and playing-now equalizers throughout song lists.
